Age: 23

Background: They are of a rare Dracoborn genome known as a 'Scaleless'. This means that no draconic characteristics are present save for their golden irises and slitted pupils. However, for some reason this does wonders for their intelligence, granting them incredible craftiness and talent in the arts of sorcery. Whyen in particular was skilled in sound-based magic, able to copy the voices of just about anyone and anything they hear. Volunteering in the Bring Magic Back Program, to bring mana back to Middle Earth after centuries, Whyen has taken an interest in the modern world of technology.

Trivia: Whyen is also adept in Magitek (The combining of magic and technology).

Personality: Whyen is snarky, intelligent, prideful, resourceful, inventive, cocky, and ambitious.

Appearance: Whyen has golden-yellow glistening eyes with slit pupils, brown hair, and band-brown skin. Their attire consists of a brick-red long-sleeve shirt with a marking of a light red sword on it, blue jeans with a yellow button, white long socks, and light-blue sneakers. (Their appearance can change however they want, except for their eyes) Whyen stands at 6' 7" (200 cm)
